sources.title: Housing supply and delivery
sources.facts: Standard method, five-year supply and Housing Delivery Test concepts; guidance includes a 1 July 2026 buffer rule.
sources.guard: National calculations and tests do not prove a specific site is deliverable or permitted.

sources.title: NPPF: Delivering a sufficient supply of homes
sources.facts: Policy covers site supply, trajectories, rural housing and exception sites.
sources.guard: National policy does not establish exact-site allocation, permission, tenure or delivery.

sources.title: Publishing your local plan housing requirement
sources.facts: LPAs must publish housing-requirement data under the Planning Data (England) Regulations 2026.
sources.guard: Published requirement data does not prove housing completion or site availability.

sources.title: Local plans: housing land supply evidence
sources.facts: Templates support presentation of allocation and five-year-supply evidence at examination.
sources.guard: A template or asserted trajectory is not proof of construction or deliverability.

sources.title: Housing needs of different groups
sources.facts: Guidance includes rural exception sites and evidence of local affordable-housing need.
sources.guard: General need evidence does not prove a specific household, tenure mix or site viability.

sources.title: First Homes
sources.facts: Defines First Homes and planning implementation including exception sites.
sources.guard: Product guidance does not prove eligibility, valuation, discount, restriction or sale.

sources.title: Planning obligations
sources.facts: Explains planning-obligation use, including affordable housing and rural exception sites.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove an executed deed, contribution, trigger, payment or discharge.

sources.title: First Homes local authority guidance notes
sources.facts: Describes local-authority roles in implementing the First Homes scheme.
sources.guard: Administrative guidance does not prove scheme funding, applicant eligibility or completion.
